Appearance
From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: porno-, Porno, pornô, pornó, and põrnõ

English

Etymology

Clipping of pornographic or pornography. Attested from mid-20th century.

Pronunciation

  • (Received Pronunciation) IPA(key): /ˈpɔːnəʊ/
  • Audio (Southern England):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɔː(ɹ)nəʊ

Adjective

porno (not comparable)

  1. Pornographic. [from the 1950s]
    That's a porno film.
    • 1973 January 21, Vincent Canby, “What Are We To Think of ‘Deep Throat’?”, in The New York Times‎[1], →ISSN:
      For reasons that still baffle me, “Deep Throat” became the one porno film in New York chic to see and to seen at, even before the court case, even before Earl Wilson wrote about it.
    • 1978, Mario Pei, Weasel Words: The Art of Saying what You Don't Mean, page 15:
      […] ultra-risqué pictures verging on the pornographic (the most porno of the last-named have not yet made it to the TV screen, but they are getting there fast—witness the storm of protests over the situation comedy “Soap”).

Synonyms

  • porn

Noun

porno (countable and uncountable, plural pornos)

  1. (uncountable) Pornography.
    • 2004, Martin Amis, Vintage Amis, page 190:
      In any case, porno is littered—porno is heaped—with the deaths of feelings.
  2. (countable) A pornographic film.
    They watched a few pornos.

Estonian

Etymology

Clipping of pornograafia.

Pronunciation

  • IPA(key): /ˈporno/
  • Hyphenation: por‧no

Noun

porno (genitive porno, partitive pornot)

  1. porn
    Öösel aga võib palju pornot vaadata.
    But at night you can watch a lot of porn.
  2. (colloquial, figurative) Something stupid, annoying, tedious.
    30 lapsele võõrkeele õpetamine on ikka paras porno küll.
    Teaching a foreign language to 30 children is really tedious.
    (literally, “Teaching a foreign language to 30 children is porn.”)
    1. Something of poor quality.
    2. A scandalous mess.
      Poliitiline porno.
      Political anarchy.
      (literally, “Political porn.”)

      Mam za to, zo njejsu ćerpjenja tutoho časa ničo porno přichodnej krasnosći, kotraž so nad nami zjewi.
      I find that sufferings of this time are nothing in contrast to the future glory that is coming upon us.
  2. except, besides, apart from
    Synonym: nimo

Preposition

porno [with dative]

  1. next to, beside, alongside, adjacent to, near, near to
